BDI.note: The document says nothing on rules or authorities for AI harms.
The document says nothing on AI use by a government body.
AgriHyphen AI is a company product used by farmers; no public body is stated to use it.

facts.fact: Burundian company Hyphen Tech developed the AgriHyphen AI app, a machine-learning tool that recognises 37 diseases across seven crops and is in use by farmers, according to Global South World.
